Name: Colombian Washed Decaf
Desc:
Processed at CR3-Kaffeeveredelung M. Hermsen in Bremen, Germany, one of the most respected decaffeination facilities in the world, this coffee is gently treated to preserve structure, aroma, and flavour integrity. The result is a decaf that tastes intentional, not compromised. The roast profile is deliberately calibrated to draw out depth and balance, allowing the coffee’s natural qualities to shine across brewing styles. From French press to espresso, it remains composed, expressive, and reliable. In the cup, it is rich and rounded, with a smooth finish and quiet complexity offering the full sensory experience of specialty coffee, without the caffeine. A decaf for those who still care deeply about what’s in their cup. 
 Tasting Notes :  Dark Chocolate · Roasted Almonds · Caramel

Name: Liquid Gold - Aura estate
Desc:
Aura Farming – Dry Osmosis Process Method. Grown at 3700ft above sea level, Liquid Gold is crafted from Coffee cherries harvested at a ripeness level of above 95%. After harvesting, the cherries are washed, and all floating fruits are removed to ensure quality selection. The coffee cherries are taken to raised beds for drying and dried until it reaches 45% moisture. The cherries are then transferred to a container and fermented anaerobically for 48 hours. After fermentation, they are moved to raised beds and dried slowly for 25 days. During the drying period, temperature and relative humidity are carefully monitored and maintained to ensure uniform drying and preserve coffee quality.  
  Tasting Notes:   
  Figs • Strawberry • Peaches

Name: Ratnagiri Estate: Jasmine Kissed Cranberry
Desc:
Jasmine kissed cranberry - 100 % arabica that is sourced from  Chikmagalur, grown at an altitude of approximately 4,100ft to 4,500ft. It gets its unique name through a process which include a strain of yeast used to create a carbon dioxide-rich environment during fermentation in stainless-steel fermenters. A remarkable level of complexity in the beans is created by this process, laying the groundwork for a wonderful cup of coffee. Steady drying on raised beds is the next important step, which lets the flavors gradually develop and intensify. After another 30 days of continuous stirring, the coffee undergoes additional drying developing  scent of jasmine, complex notes of raspberries, cranberries, and sparkling malic acidity with a lingering floral aftertaste. 
 Tasting Notes: Grapefruit, Pomegranate, Rose

Name: Rwanda Shyira
Desc:
Rwanda Shyira (Washed) is a refined, high-altitude coffee that perfectly captures the elegance Rwanda is known for. Grown in the Nyabihu highlands at around 6,000 feet and carefully washed at the Shyira Washing Station, it offers remarkable clarity and balance. The cup opens with bright clementine like acidity, softens into honeydew sweetness, and finishes clean and floral. When brewed as a pour over, this coffee is vibrant yet composed an expressive, quietly sophisticated example of classic Rwandan terroir.  
 Tasting Notes :  Maple · Cacao Nibs· Green Apple
